children: NVIDIA (NVDA) got orders from Chinese firms for 3M+ RTX PRO 5500 GPUs (list value ~ $35B). NVIDIA warned deliveries may be only 5%–10% of orders; global supply may cap near 3M units by 2027.
NVIDIA invested $2 billion in CoreWeave equity and agreed in September to buy any unsold CoreWeave capacity through 2032 for $6.3 billion, securing long‑term data‑center supply.
US export controls limit Nvidia NVDA B300 shipments to China and require case-by-case licensing for H200. Nvidia says TSMC capacity shifts to Rubin from 2027, may cause delivery delays.
NVIDIA (NVDA) forecasts at least $20B revenue from its Vera platform this fiscal year and pegs the CPU market opportunity at about $200B, highlighting data-center and AI hardware potential.
NVDA sees strong Chinese AI hardware demand but faces supply limits from TSMC and ASML. Initial allocation to partners may be about 5–10%; no rapid wafer-partner or fab expansion expected.
NVIDIA (NVDA) reported in its 10-Q that five customers made up 70% of accounts receivable: 22%, 14%, 13%, 11% and 10%, highlighting customer concentration risk for traders.
Amazon launched TorchNeuron to run PyTorch on Trainium with one config change, cited as adding pressure to NVIDIA (NVDA) by easing moves off CUDA and onto Amazon hardware.
NVIDIA (NVDA) pledged nearly $10 billion for European AI R&D and partnerships, including investments in four German startups to boost AI in manufacturing, robotics, healthcare, audio and satellites.
NVIDIA (NVDA) launched an Open Agent Safety Platform to help developers control AI agents and limit rogue model behavior, expanding its AI software lineup alongside existing hardware.
NVIDIA (NVDA) partnered with Reliance Jio in 2023 to build cloud infrastructure and language models. No recent NVDA-specific events were reported in the past few days.
